subject: 南昌路212弄1–10号铁门后上层两组外开木窗
registration: The green plate reads 212弄1–10号、南昌路. The entry is listed jointly with 244弄 under 5A068. The visible upper wall is separated from the street pillars by a recessed entrance.
visible_fabric: Two masonry openings, each with three outward wooden faces visible at the left, middle and right hinge positions. Each resolved face in the September still has four stacked rows, with a narrow central vertical glazing bar. The west bay's outermost west face is nearly edge-on. December scenes show the same two wall openings and different leaf positions. The narrow dark line at the back of a middle face does not uniquely identify an additional hidden leaf.
condition: Hinge stations use the fixed jamb, centre-post and opposite jamb. Individual leaf widths are estimated at one quarter of a bay. Swing is fitted to the September upper free tips, while the divisions and glazed surface are read directly. Frame/reveal depths, interior shadow and putty thickness are estimates. Thin wire, washing and portable equipment fall outside the model.
rights_note: The construction derives from a cropped and perspective-read CC BY-SA 4.0 photograph. Survey-image pixel coordinates and source identifiers are distributed as numerical observations.
